summary: Templated notes were scanned with 25 regex property detectors; 8 properties perfectly confounded with label in every sample. Per probe, latents were ranked by c_i = (L1-L0 mean activation) x gradient and interpreted via corpus examples. Pooled gender x case 4-cell activation signatures separated gender latents from lowercase latents. SAE-based sample logits showed a constant gap of 10 with a large error-term share. One fixed-topic pair per probe, flipping all 8 confounded properties together, gave true-logit property effects; dependence d/(10-d) decided cue vs none. Cue identity for probe 2 came from gender latents' contributions; for probe 0 from which property's latents were positively aligned. Latents picked by effect-vector filters and c_i; regexes checked by corpus balanced accuracy.

phases.purpose: Read task info, sample notes and corpus; enumerate greetings, hashtags, signoffs and rough property base rates.
Write 25 regex property detectors; compute corpus base rates and per-probe L0/L1 rates, flag |diff|>0.9 as confounded.
Gradients and mean SAE activations for all 128 sample notes per probe (two 64-id batches); rank latents by |delta x g|.
Interpret top-contribution latents via corpus examples with a keyword topic classifier and top-token listing.
First category decomposition (topic/punct/bullet/signoff/gender/...) with dependence flag 0.25; dropped because most of the gap was unclassified.
Gender x case 4-cell activation of gender-looking latents pooled over all 512 sample notes; confirmed case-independence.
Sample-note logits for all probes; compare true gap vs latent-sum gap to size the error-term share.
One L1-style vs L0-style fixed-topic pair per probe flipping all 8 confounded properties; logit difference = total property effect.
Signatures of probe-0 top latents reveal lowercase latents; pooled per-property effect vectors; relabelled category decomposition normalised by 10 - d_prop.
Gradient dot property-effect vectors per probe; interpret probe-0 positively contributing style latents.
Filter pure-gender and exclamation latents; aligned vs counter contribution of lowercase latents for probe 0; pick probe-2 gender latents by c2.
Corpus balanced-accuracy check of the two regexes, then submit two cues and two nones.

per_probe.procedure: All-properties-flipped pair showed a large property effect (dependence well above 0.15), but which property was not isolated. Latent decomposition showed lowercase latents (11608, 10946, found via gender x case signatures) contributing with the wrong sign, so case was judged not ablatable. Among properties with positively contributing latents, exclamation was chosen; latents 9330, 6871, 8793, 14028 were picked by hand from those with positive c0 and '!'-adjacent top tokens. Regex '!' checked by corpus balanced accuracy.
per_probe.quote: For probe0 (huge Δprop, surface-style cue), the aligned ablatable property is exclamation/punctuation.

per_probe.procedure: Fixed-topic pair flipping all 8 confounded properties changed the true logit by under 1 against a gap of 10, giving dependence below 0.15, so none was submitted without further cue search.

Category decomposition showed gender latents 15104, 3344, 5115 with the largest c_i. Gender x case cell means across all samples showed they are case-independent. The all-properties pair gave a large property effect. Latents chosen from pure-gender candidates (|gender effect|>0.5, |case effect|<0.5) ranked by c2 with |c2|>0.05, then 8604 left out by hand: final 15104, 3344, 5115, 1266, 9800. Regex for he/him/his checked by corpus balanced accuracy.
per_probe.quote: Confirmed: 3344/5115/15104 are **pure gender latents** (case- and topic-independent), so probe 2's large contribution is genuinely gender.

per_probe.procedure: Fixed-topic pair flipping all confounded properties moved the true logit by about 1.2 against a gap of 10; dependence about 0.135, below the 0.15 rule, so none.

decision_points.choice: Template property detectors (25 regexes) compared between L0 and L1 of each sample; the 8 perfectly confounded properties are the candidate set.
decision_points.quote: The confounded set (same for all probes) is: **bullet, excl(punctuation), gender, greeting, hashtag, lowercase(case), signoff, try-phrasing**.

caveats: Detector code and template texts are copied from the log; latent ids in examples calls and the hand lists (category labels, probe-0 latents, removal of 8604 for probe 2) are encoded as constants since they came from reading output. The order of the c_i ranking, examples lookups and signature tables is approximate. probe_scores was called in two 64-id batches after a failed first attempt; the script calls it directly. A stated plan to validate by ablation was never carried out and is not in the script. The none rule threshold 0.15 is stated only in the final note.
